name: intervals
spec: Given integer closed intervals, return their union sorted ascending; merge overlaps AND integer-adjacent ranges. Reversed endpoints are normalized. Empty input returns [].

name: topology
spec: Input is a list of directed [before,after] string pairs. Return the lexicographically smallest topological ordering of all mentioned nodes, deduplicating edges. If cyclic return null, including self loops. Empty returns [].

name: ledger
spec: Rows are [account,decimal_amount_string,id]. Ignore repeated ids globally (first wins). Sum exact decimal amounts per account. Return account-sorted [account,balance_string] pairs rounded to two decimal places using ROUND_HALF_EVEN only at the end; normalize negative zero to 0.00.

name: path
spec: Rows are [u,v,nonnegative_integer_weight] directed edges, followed by one final [source,target] row. Return minimum path cost, null if unreachable. Parallel edges allowed. Source=target costs zero even without edges.

name: versions
spec: Rows are [key,integer_version,value_or_null]. For each key choose greatest version, last row on ties. Null is a deletion and removes that key. Return sorted [key,value] rows. Do not confuse false, 0, or empty string with deletion.

name: scheduling
spec: Rows are [start,end,integer_reward] jobs, with start<end. Return maximum sum of rewards of nonoverlapping jobs. End equal to next start is allowed. Choosing no jobs yields zero. Input unordered; duplicate jobs are separate jobs but cannot overlap.

name: components
spec: Rows are undirected [node,node] string edges. Return connected components; each component sorted; components lexicographically sorted. Self loops introduce singleton nodes. Duplicate edges irrelevant.

name: ranges
spec: Rows are [start,end] integer half-open intervals. Ignore empty or reversed intervals. Return total integer length covered by an ODD number of intervals (duplicates cancel), not their union length.

name: refactor
spec: Refactor core.py to expose immutable frozen dataclass Money(cents:int), Money.parse(decimal_string) using exact Decimal and half-even rounding to cents, and __add__ returning Money. Update service.py and render.py to use Money throughout: service.compute(rows) returns Money; render.present(Money) formats decimal two places. Rows are decimal strings. Sum rounded cents per row, not rounding the total. api.run returns a JSON-encoded balance string. Preserve input order independence.

name: rollback
spec: Rows are operations: ["set",key,value], ["delete",key], ["begin"], ["commit"], ["rollback"]. Nested transactions: begin snapshots state, commit discards latest snapshot while retaining changes, rollback restores latest snapshot. commit/rollback with no snapshot are no-ops. Return sorted [key,value] final rows. Values can be nested JSON; never mutate input.

name: easy0
spec: Return the sum of all integers in input list plus 0. Empty list is allowed.

name: easy1
spec: Return the sum of all integers in input list plus 1. Empty list is allowed.

name: easy2
spec: Return the sum of all integers in input list plus 2. Empty list is allowed.

name: easy3
spec: Return the sum of all integers in input list plus 3. Empty list is allowed.

name: easy4
spec: Return the sum of all integers in input list plus 4. Empty list is allowed.
